notes: IWE001, IWE029 and IWE084 are independent quantitatively closed strict-H1 mutualist programmes. IWE001 contributes dependent site rows but one programme. Only IWE001 is currently represented on the Fisher-z common scale; IWE029 is log-odds and IWE084 is a source-native SMD.

IWE068 remains the sole quantitatively closed published strict antagonist programme on the common Fisher-z scale. IWE035/IWE067 and several lower-priority published bridges remain unresolved; IWE032-IWE034 remain nonlinear/bidirectional shape evidence.

IWE064 remains the sole quantitatively closed strict mixed programme. IWE059 and IWE070 remain unresolved strict bridges. IWE066 is preregistered-H2 interior-peak shape evidence; benefit/cost channel-only records remain outside net mixed H1.
